name: Archmage Chest
description: A truly spirited garb for magicians and casters. The fabric was laboriously dyed with deep cobalt pigment derived from imported nightblooms.

name: Archmage Gloves
description: Gloves which were worn by the most talented, renowned and successful mages of the kingdom.

name: Archmage Hat

name: Archmage Trousers
description: The pants are elegantly held together with cobalt stitching and thread. The color represents sophistication and the superiority of the mind.

name: Artificer's Boots

name: Artificer's Gloves

name: Artificer's Helmet

name: Artificer's Pants

name: Ashwind Strider Gloves

name: Ashwind Strider Hood

name: Ashwind Strider Pants

name: Assassin Trousers

name: Blood Rose Chestplate
description: A laced-up metal bodice that births a crinoline-esque cage. You shan't let these shackles fool you. No band, and no blood can manacle the wrath of the Blood Rose.

name: Blood Rose Gloves
description: Sharp claws and a sharper tongue that refuses to be silenced - such are both sword and shield of the Blood Rose.

name: Blood Rose Mail Coif
description: A chainmail coif, crowned with a wreath of roses and thorns. Beauty and pain, pleasure and despair - they all coalesce in her halo.

name: Blood Rose Pants
description: Full metal armor with flourishing lines, swinging around the leg like ensnaring vines. Their thorns may prick, tear, and break her, but a wounded deer leaps highest , so they say.

name: Bloodfeather Chest
description: With this chest piece, you can cut through the woods with ease, remaining undetected as you prepare your next strike.

name: Bloodfeather Gloves
description: Adorned with a crystal and gold trim, these gloves give you a firm grip on your daggers - ideal for strikes from behind.

name: Bloodfeather Helmet
description: This head armor combines a mask, cloth, and horns. For most foes, it will be the last thing they see when you catch them by surprise.

name: Bloodfeather Pants
description: Designed for stealth, these neutral pants make sneaking through the thicket effortless.

name: Bloodfeather Shoes
description: With these shoes, maintain your stance and recover before launching your next attack.

name: Bloomheart Fruit
description: The Bloomheart Fruit takes it's time to ripen, but when it's ready something so juicy and sweet awaits you. It's worth the patience.

name: Ectoplasm Soup
description: Unnerving goo. It bestows great powers on those who eat it.

description: Cloven, finely segmented boots. Their shape is reminiscent of Fae Deer hooves.

name: Efflorescent Hope Chest
description: This royal chest piece frames a gleaming gem as its heart, reminding the wearer that hope will prevail. Taupe colored sleeves drape at the sides like a chrysalis being shed. The shoulders are accentuated by wing- or petal-like shapes, blossoming outwards.

name: Efflorescent Hope Flower Crown

name: Efflorescent Hope Gloves

name: Efflorescent Hope Pants
description: Deep blue pants made from opaque material. With these, warmth will embrace you like a cocoon.

name: Eggs

Overcharge: This wand holds a chance to amplify its damage output. Attacks deal bonus damage up to the overcharge percentage. Multishot: Fires multiple projectiles but at reduced damage.

name: Electric Nerve

name: Ember Carapace

name: Emberfin
description: This striking red fish is marked with black stripes. Its shimmering scales resemble cooling embers, earning it the name "Emberfin".

name: Emberguard Boots
description: Imposing boots that leave a deep imprint wherever they step. They possess additional plating towards the outer sides, protecting the wearer from low blows.

name: Emberguard Chestplate

name: Emberguard Gloves

name: Emberguard Helmet

name: Emberguard Pants
description: A pattern ripples across the fabric, creating subtle peaks and valleys as fingers draw across it.

name: Emberguard Shield
description: An agile shield that feels as though it could be used well offensively. Three small dots adorn its heart, representing humanity, the Ancients, and the Flameborn between.

name: Embervale Miniature Showcase

description: Vibrant amethyst-colored plumes adorn this helmet, indicating that the previous wearer might have been a royal commander.

name: Exclusive Hollow Pants
description: Pants fit for a midnight march. The metal plating is polished enough to reflect the moonlight.

name: Exotic Fruit Salad
description: A vibrant mix of Prickle Pearl, Bloomheart Fruit, Strawberries, and Dates. Sweet, exotic, and refreshingly simple.

name: Exploding Arrow IV
description: A Special Arrow that delivers an explosive surprise. Strikes with immense firepower.

name: Explorer Boots
description: The wilderness will bend to your will in no time when you face it wearing these sturdy, bite-proof boots.

name: Explorer Coat
description: The backpack provides ample space for storing unknown flora or newly discovered artifacts while adventuring!

name: Explorer Gloves
description: Fantastic gloves for digging up secrets, uncovering treasures, or cartographing never-before-seen lands!

name: Explorer Helmet
description: Dashing headgear with a set of goggles. They protect the wearer's eyes from vapors and water but were also used while gliding on wind currents back in the day.

name: Explorer Pants
description: Even after many weeks on the road, these pants will still be comfortable and in good shape.

name: Explosive Arrow I
description: A special arrow that delivers an explosive surprise.

name: Explosive Arrow II
description: A special arrow that delivers an explosive surprise. Strikes with improved firepower.

name: Explosive Arrow III
description: A special arrow that delivers an explosive surprise. Strikes with greatly improved firepower.

name: Explosive Barrel
description: A decorative item for everyone's home.

name: Explosive Crawler
description: A mindless, throwable drone made from critter carapaces. Once deployed, the crawler will seek the nearest enemy and combust. The damage caused by this Throwable scales with your Dexterity attribute.

name: Explosive Powder Ball
description: An explosive with astounding power that can be thrown. The damage caused by this Throwable scales with your Dexterity attribute.

name: Explosive Powder Ball Net
description: An explosive with astounding power that can be thrown. The damage caused by this Throwable scales with your Dexterity attribute.

name: Extraordinary Ectoplasm
description: A curious blend. Ground, mixed and left to settle. The important thing is that it works. Probably.

name: Extraordinary Ectoplasm Soup
description: A thick, viscous soup made from volatile extoplasm. It tastes vaguely minty.

name: Extraordinary Glider
description: This Glider will allow you to travel extraordinarily long distances.

name: Fabric
description: A sturdy material that was woven out of linen. It revolutionized the clothing industry due to its flexibility and durability. It looks better as well.

name: Fae Deer Farmer Boots
description: At first glance, these brown leather boots appear ordinary. A closer inspection reveals the cloven segment towards the front, which leaves "hoov"-like prints in the mud.

name: Fae Deer Farmer Gloves
description: Two-toned leather gloves with light stitching. Their pattern gives them an almost whimsical feel.

name: Fae Deer Farmer Hood
description: A fanciful hood with expressive animal ears and a draping cape. It's made from layers of faintly dotted fur and is well-suited for walking among the Fae Deer as a trusted friend and companion.

name: Fae Deer Farmer Overalls
description: A farmhand's overalls. The deep pockets are very helpful when gathering herbs or storing animal feed.

name: Fae Deer Farmer Shirt
description: A short-sleeved linen shirt that's topped with an orange fur cape. The cape flows down the wearer's back and ends in pieces that wave in the wind like a tail.

name: Fae Deer Feeder
description: A feeding device that holds Fae Deer food.

name: Fae Deer Food
description: Nutritious Fae Deer food for tame animals on your farm.

name: Fae Deer Food Bait
description: Food for attracting and taming a Fae Deer.

name: Fae Deer Pillow
description: A decorative pillow that's been adorned with a Fae Deer motif. It seems to be running wild through the wind and bushes.

name: Fancy Stone Block
description: A stone block often used for building sturdy soundproof walls.

name: Farm Animal Pillow
description: A cozy bed for farm animals.

name: Farm Soil
description: Healthy soil that will increase the growing speed of most plants.

name: Farmer Boots
description: Simple boots for hardworking folk.

name: Farmer Garb
description: Faintly smells of grain, sweet summer days, and honey.

name: Farmer Hat
description: It keeps the sun out of your tired eyes. That's all it has to do!

name: Farmer Pants
description: Sunbleached pants, carefully patched and sown with leftover thread. The cloth is wearing thin in some areas...

name: Feather
description: A feather of a bird or creature of some kind. Weighing next to nothing, it has to be useful for something.

name: Fell Confusion Pheromones
description: Can be thrown to create a Pheromone Cloud that confuses Fell enemies, who run around in panic when affected.

name: Fell Crimson Critter Queen Head
description: It looks oddly similar to the Fell Critter Queen, just a different color.

name: Fell Crimson Critter Queen Trophy
description: Her red glowing head is smaller than your memory suggested and her mandibles less threatening.

name: Fell Critter Queen Head
description: The Fell Critter Queen Head looks strangely small without the bulk that had once followed behind it.

name: Fell Critter Queen Trophy
description: The Fell Critter Queen's antennas are stiff with age, and her curved, fang-like mandibles still frame her mouth. You don't feel terror when looking at them now; they seem almost delicate to your touch.

name: Fell Curse Cleansing Tonic
description: Removes Fell Curse upon use. Also applies a buff that prevents the curse from affecting the user for an hour.

name: Fell Cyclops Head
description: The head of a Shroud infested Cyclops. It has pretty bad breath, even now.

name: Fell Cyclops Trophy
description: A giant trophy, weighing countless pounds. Mounting this on the wall is no easy task.

name: Fell Dragon Youngling Head
description: Its head alone weighs a monstrous amount. the shimmering scales are ice-cold.

name: Fell Dragon Youngling Trophy
description: A lonely soul, brought low by the shroud - and set free by your blade.

name: Fell Fashion
description: Look lole a Fell Foe, but make it fashion. This blue color palette mirrors the hues of the Shroud, with a touch of aquamarine added. This color palette can be made with Veilwater Basin materials.

name: Fell Heart
description: The faded heart of a Fell Foe. Its potent essence is key in crafting resilient armor and powerful healing spells.

name: Fell Monstrosity Head
description: Despair, hatred, loneliness... It grasps at anything to fill the void and leaves nothing but dust.

name: Fell Monstrosity Trophy
description: Inside, you can see nothingness. The absence of matter - of sanity and sanctum.

name: Fell Sicklescythe Head
description: There's still a faint glow behind its eyes. Hopefully, they won't follow your every move.

name: Fell Sicklescythe Trophy
description: Sometimes, the muscles around the eyes still twitch. It's natural, and not worrying. Mostly.

name: Fell Striker Head
description: The head of a Fell Striker. The eyes have been fully absorbed into fungal growth... so they're blinded by more than rage.

name: Fell Striker Trophy
description: This fight made you stop believing in safe corners. You can be sure that he always closes the gap between you two. Maybe nailed to your walls, he will finally leave you be.

name: Fell Thunderbrute Head
description: Its brain has been replaced by fungi and slush, but it's still tremendously heavy. The face is permanently petrified with a bitter expression.

name: Fell Thunderbrute Trophy
description: Mount it inside your halls to honor the Flame!

name: Fell Wispwyvern Head
description: When its luminous brood skipped over the waves near Pikemead's Reach, it was seen as a good omen. Unfortunately, no being, no matter how small, escapes the corrupting grasp of the Shroud.

name: Fell Wispwyvern Trophy
description: The change of tides was not kind to this creature. Perhaps it can finally rest.

name: Fenrig's Axe
description: An axe made for cutting down trees. Slightly less effective for fighting off wolves.

name: Fern Pot
description: A lovely pot of flowers to beautify your world.

name: Fire Totem I
description: Summons a totem that launches fiery projectiles at enemies and explodes when it expires. Maximum amount of summoned totems is 1 by default which can be increased via skills.

description: Shiny red bricks that are crafted by hardening Lump of Clay under a heat even a Flameborn has issues with.

name: Fired Bricks Block
description: A block made of Fired Brick. It has a dull red color.

description: An illumination item that can be placed in your home.

description: A fireplace that will provide warmth once placed in your home. It's simple, but sufficient for cooking one - ingredient meals and gaining the Rested buff

name: Fish Bones
description: Small fish bones that can be used in crafting. They feel brittle in your hands, but they'd be a terrible pain if stuck in your throat.

name: Fish Chowder
description: A hearty, creamy soup made with tender chunks of fish and fresh vegetables.

name: Fish Cutlet
description: Fish cut into thick slices, be aware of the the bones, but you can still enjoy it.

name: Fish Drying Rack
description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

name: Fish Filet
description: The Filet of an epic fish, don't worry about any fish bones, they have been thoroughly removed.

name: Fish Poison Gland
description: Potent in small doses. A staple ingredient for poison-based concoctions.

name: Fish Scales
description: The scales are still warm when removed from the fish. They never fully cool and are popular under fire mages for obvious reasons.

name: Fish Tacos
description: Crispy fish tacos filled with a hearty plantain rice.

name: Fish Teeth
description: The threatening teeth of a fish that is no threat anymore.

name: Fish Trophy Board
description: A wall-mounted board that lets you display all your fishing achievements.

name: Flame Altar
description: Place this Flame Altar above the Shroud to mark your home. Build inside the marked area around the Flame Altar.

name: Flame Arcanist Boots
description: Pointy-toed shoes that curl upwards ever so slightly near the front. They feel nice and cool on the feet.

name: Flame Arcanist Chest
description: An admiral blue-colored garment often worn by magic scholars who revere the Mother Flame. The cape attached to the shoulders falls in layers and ends in uneven trim, dancing like little spouts of fire as it moves in the wind.

name: Flame Arcanist Gloves
description: Gilded gloves that brandish both royal blue and gold. They're emblazoned with long, metal claws that tip the gloves.

name: Flame Arcanist Hat
description: A voluptuous, pointed wizard hat! The crowning glory of clothing for the magically inclined.

name: Flame Arcanist Pants
description: An assortment of dark layers that protect the wearer's legs from becoming singed, scorched, or incinerated when conjuring fire magic.

name: Flame Mosaic Showcase
description: A useful frame that can hold the pieces to a Flame mosaic. It must be placed on the ground.

name: Flame Pact Boots
description: Brown boots equipped with belt buckles and shoe laces. Perfect for a stroll through your wonderful village, castle, or underground bunker.

name: Flame Pact Gloves
description: Gloves adorned with glowing, green gems. No matter what you're rebuilding or tearing down - you'll always look fashionable with these!

name: Flame Pact Hat
description: A floppy hat with red feathers.

name: Flame Pact Pants
description: Light brown pants. Comfortable and distinguished in their simplicity.

name: Flame Pact Vest
description: The best way to elevate your outfit is by extensively adding belts and straps to an inflationary degree, or so they say. A golden sigil on the chest signals your dedication to the Flame.

name: Flammable Goo
description: A sticky and highly flammable substance. Handle with care!

name: Flare Arrow
description: Scouting ahead can be quite challenging, especially in the dark. The Flare Arrow leaves a flare at the point of impact, spending a little light.

name: Flask of the Fell
description: The Shroud grants power to not only the Fell, but to whoever drinks from this flask.

name: Flat Bread
description: A simple meal, granting a lasting Melee Damage boost upon consumption. It tastes better in combination with other things, though.

name: Flax
description: A popular plant due to its strong fibers. It can be used to make linen.

name: Flax Plant Pot
description: A lovely pot of flowers to beautify your world.

name: Flax Seedling
description: A seedling that will grow into a plant when sown in the right soil. Once fully grown, it can be harvested once.

name: Flightless Redtail Pillow
description: A comfortable pillow with a bird on it. The bird may not be able to fly, but it still looks stylish!

name: Flint
description: A mix of flint and basalt, with a hint of faded lavender. This color palette can be made with Revelwood materials.

name: Flint Arrow
description: A slightly enhanced version of the Wooden Arrow, reinforced with small pieces of flint at the tip.

name: Flintstone
description: A soft small rock that became famous for its ability to release sparks. It has been associated with the Flame ever since.

name: Floor Drain
description: This drain will remove any water above it. Can be placed on the floor.

name: Flour
description: Flour that can be created by grinding Wheat Grains to dust.

name: Flower Snake
description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

name: Flower Soil
description: The perfect soil for growing beautiful flowers.

name: Flower Vase
description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

name: Flower Wreath
description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

name: Fluffy Boots
description: These boots are stuffed with extra fluff, thus keeping your feet nice and warm in the snow.

name: Fluffy Hood
description: A nice, cream-colored hood to keep you warm and snug. The droopy little ears are purely fashionable, but aren't they cute?

name: Fluffy Mittens
description: These gloves were patched together with two different fabrics. They re-create the look of "hooves".

name: Fluffy Pants
description: These pants are nothing special on the outside, but inside, they're lined with a fur layer.

name: Fluffy Tunic
description: A warm tunic, lined with white wool. The sleeves are long and wide, so it's fun to swing your arms around gleefully!

name: Flute
description: A flute carved bone. You can use it to make music.

name: Food Plate
description: A wooden plate to display cooked food on a table.

name: Forest Beet
description: A root brimming with energy, but not very effective in its raw form. Improves the Dexterity of the consumer.

name: Forge
description: A workplace that will enable new crafting possibilities for the Blacksmith

name: Forgotten Library
description: The warm and dusty green hues remind you of old leather-bound books with frayed and copper clasps. This color palette can be made with Nomad Highlands materials.

name: Fossil Showcase (2 Medium Slots)
description: This is a showcase for Fossil Collection Items usually found in quarries, material veins, or dig sites.

name: Fossil Showcase (2 Small Slots)
description: This is a showcase for Fossil Collection Items usually found in quarries, material veins, or dig sites.

name: Fossil Showcase (3 Small and 2 Medium Slots)
description: This is a showcase for Fossil Collection Items usually found in quarries, material veins, or dig sites.

name: Fossil Showcase (3 Small Slots)
description: This is a showcase for Fossil Collection Items usually found in quarries, material veins, or dig sites.

name: Fossilized Bone
description: Over the years, untouched by anyone, the bones of all kind of magical creatures have hardened and turned to stone. A rare material due to its limited availibility and high magical capacity.

name: Fossilized Bone Arrow
description: An arrow enhanced with pieces of Fossilized Bone. Strikingly beautiful and deadly.

name: Fossilized Bone Dust
description: Grinding the Fossilized Bone into dust frees its inherent magical attributes and makes it more handy for further production steps.

name: Fowler Boots
description: With these weighted soles, even shaky or uneven ground will not disturb your aim.

name: Fowler Chest
description: The details on this piece of upper body armor were greatly inspired by wing feathers.

name: Fowler Gloves
description: Wearing these gloves makes the pulse slow down mysteriously before going in for the kill, thus steadying the hands.

name: Fowler Helmet
description: The metal adornment on this hood faintly resembles the beak of a hawk.

name: Fowler Trousers
description: The pants were made from varied materials and protect all the most important areas adequately.

name: Fresh Shroud Spore
description: Fresh Shroud spores, used to craft medicines that can cure the Shroud curse.

name: Fried Rice
description: If pure, cooked rice is a bit too plain for you, then this fried rice might satisfy your needs. The added egg breaks up the granular texture of the rice, and the vegetables create a punch of flavor!

name: Frizzy Goat Milk
description: A delicious jug of Frizzy Goat milk. Drinking it will grant you stamina and stamina regeneration.

name: Frog
description: A tiny frog. He could be your best friend if you didn't need to use him as fish bait. Found in the Veilwater Basin and especially helpful to catch epic fish.

name: Frog In The Grass
description: Muted shades of green help you blend in, almost invisible as you chase little frogs through the grass This color palette can be made with Veilwater Basin materials.

name: From Dusk Till Dawn
description: Through the dark night until dawn drapes the ski in golden - yellow and red hues. This color combination would look stunning on a flag too! This color palette can be made with Veilwater Basin materials.

name: Frostbite Slasher Boots
description: Heavy boots with metal caps, perfect for kicking down doors or crushing skulls under your heel.

name: Frostbite Slasher Chest
description: A breezy vest layered on top of a long shirt. The additional belt buckle strapped across the chest holds some spare blades.

name: Frostbite Slasher Gloves
description: Padded gloves made from thick white cloth and deep blue leather arm guards. A small buckle and cyan string hold them together. The fingertips are left bare, so you can still feel the pulse of the hunt.

name: Frostbite Slasher Hood
description: The fearsome metal mask is only partially covered by the hood, leaving most of its sharp edges and lines visible to your prey.

name: Frostbite Slasher Trousers
description: This pair of pants has ample space for carrying exposed blades and hidden toxins.

name: Fruit Bowl
description: A refreshing bowl of fruits with positive health benefits.

name: Fur Boots
description: Warmer and sturdier than simple cloth.

name: Fur Chest
description: Reinforced with Metal Scraps for better protection.

name: Fur Gloves
description: Simple but reliable protection for hands.

name: Fur Hood
description: Simplistic head protection. It won't guard against much, but it's better than nothing.

name: Fur Rug
description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

name: Fur Trousers
description: A little archaic, but better than cloth.

name: Furry straw mat
description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

name: Gentian
description: A star-shaped blossom that blooms in the high-up mountains. It grants more mana when consumed.

name: Gentian Plant Pot
description: A lovely pot of flowers to beautify your world.

name: Gentian Seedling
description: A seedling that will grow into a plant when sown in the right soil. Once fully grown, it can be harvested once.

name: Ghost Glider
description: A formidable Glider which can cross even the deepest trenches, allowing you to rain death from above.

name: Ghostly Shield
description: This magic shield allows you to block against physical attacks. Blocking drains stamina.

name: Giant Bone Arrow
description: An arrow made from giant bone.

name: Giant Bone Arrow II
description: An arrow made from bone.

name: Giant Bone Arrow III
description: An arrow made from bone.

name: Giant Bone Arrow IV
description: An arrow made from bone.

name: Giant Bones
description: These bones are far larger than normal and are exceptionally sturdy.

name: Giant Critter Scales
description: Massive, hardened scales. Lightweight yet incredibly tough, they are prime materials for crafting durable and flexible armor.

name: Giant Hollow Halls Banner
description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

name: Giant Telescope
description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

name: Gilded Axe
description: A steel axe, decorated with gold accents. It makes you feel much stronger, although the blade itself is most likely not improved by much.

name: Gilded Contrast
description: White and black in bold opposition, with just a thread of gold to hold it all together. Minimal, but deliberate.

name: Gilded Depths
description: Dark as the deep end, a green so rich it swallows light. Balanced with a warm gold and bright turquoise.

name: Gilded Pickaxe
description: This steel pickaxe has been further refined through the addition of gold ornaments.

name: Ginger
description: Fresh ginger, perfect for brewing hot tea to keep any cold at bay.

name: Ginger In A Jungle
description: Rich, deep hues of green evoke the jungle and thickets you must navigate. A touch of red is added, like the red ginger flowers that appear here and there, breaking up the sea of green. This color palette can be made with Veilwater Basin materials.

name: Ginger Plant Pot
description: A potted plant to beautify your home

name: Ginger Seedling
description: A seedling that will grow into a plant once sown in the right soil. Once fully grown, it can be harvested once.

name: Ginger Tea
description: This ginger tea tastes like the paragon of good health.

name: Glass
description: A wondrous material. It is transparent and offers many potential applications, especially in building and crafting!

name: Glass Shards
description: Glass broken into pieces offers many sharp edges used to enhance weapons.

name: Gleam Root
description: An underwater plant that only grows where the moonlight coats the sea floor. It has an enticing glow that spells demise for any diver willing to forget themselves in their pursuit of the light in the deep.

name: Gleam Root Diving Light
description: A throwable light that activates upon landing, even underwater. Not as strong as other light sources.

name: Gleam Root Dust
description: This powder was derived from the Gleam Root plant, which only grows at night in the Veilwater Basin.

name: Glider
description: The possibility to fly has always been a desirable trait.

name: Glimmer Gentian
description: "Glimmer Gentian" is a variant of the gentian plant that can only be found in the Albaneve Summits at night. It emits a bright pink glow and can be used to create vibrant color palettes.

name: Glimmer Gentian Tea
description: This is an herbal tea with added glimmer gentian. The Blossoms create a smooth texture and extend your Time in the shroud.

name: Globe
description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

name: Gloomberry
description: A special berry that can only be harvested at night in the Revelwood. It can be used to enhance various dishes and to create deep blue color pigments.

name: Glow Dust
description: A magical dust that can glow in the dark, consisting of the crushed remains of a Fire Fly.

name: Glow Soup
description: A weird brew emitting a blue glow...Nobody quite knows why.

name: Goalpost
description: A goalpost that can be activated via the Sparkworks system.

name: Goat Feeder
description: A feeding device that holds Goat food.

name: Goat Food
description: Nutritious Goat food for tame animals on your farm.

name: Goat Food Bait
description: Food for attracting and taming a Goat.

name: Gold Ancient S.P.D.R. Construct Trophy
description: The central eye remains visible, but no longer carries the pressure it once did. It now feels less like a weapon and more like a relic.

name: Gold Bars
description: Solid gold bars that serve as both a crafting material and a status symbol.

name: Gold Coins
description: Gold coins, ideal for bedazzling, boasting, and bribing.

name: Gold Cyclops Trophy
description: Possessing this trophy shows everyone that you are not on the Cyclops' menu — it's the other way around!

name: Gold Direwolf Trophy
description: The golden Direwolf does not show that it was victorious. it shows that you were.

name: Gold Dust
description: Gold ground to powder. It sparkles even more beautifully than before.

name: Gold Fell Crimson Critter Queen Trophy
description: Take this golden trophy as a sign of your multiple victories, but also remember: she won't stop staring back, she refuses to be covered, and to be forgotten.

name: Gold Fell Critter Queen Trophy
description: You have slain the Fell Critter Queen so many times that her golden trophy can embellish your walls. One could say you have earned the right to take her place and be the new Queen. But there was nobody left to rule.

name: Gold Fell Cyclops Trophy
description: There wasn't much substance to begin with, but now only the empty shell remains. Show off your pride with this golden trophy.

name: Gold Fell Dragon Youngling Trophy
description: As you were fighting the Fell Dragon Youngling time and time again, you could observe how its hope got whittled down to despair.

name: Gold Fell Monstrosity Trophy
description: Although you have been exposed to this sight countless times, it still exudes a sense of menace and excitement at the same time.

name: Gold Fell Sicklescythe Trophy
description: The moment before the final curse was spoken is frozen forever in this golden trophy. Thankfully, the incredible power of the flame is ever-present.

name: Gold Fell Striker Trophy
description: The severed, golden head, forever frozen in time, invites you to look within. To reach this moment, you had to perfect your fighting strategy. Well done.

name: Gold Fell Thunderbrute Trophy
description: Possessing this golden trophy proves that you dodged every sword blow and defeated your opponent with concentrated force.

name: Gold Fell Wispwyvern Trophy
description: Once thought to be a path to redemption turned into a path to damnation. Fortunately, the Flame was strong enough to avert greater disasters several times.

name: Gold Hollow Cyclops Trophy
description: The Hollow Cyclops would certainly be delighted with his gilded teeth, with which he would grin menacingly at you.

name: Gold Hollow Titan Trophy
description: The surface gleams so bright and the plume becomes a radiant crown, turning the helmet into something ceremonial. Fitting for celebrating your multiple defeats.

name: Gold Hollow Wispwyvern Trophy
description: At this point, you're a professional at not getting crushed by skeletal fury. and this trophy is proof of it.

name: Gold Hydrak'Dal Trophy
description: This trophy proves that you have defeated their leader once again. In their eyes, you must seem like a god. However, they won't worship you, they'll just despise you even more.
